etymology: Simplified from 應: a heart (心) under the eaves — the heart answering what arrives: to respond, comply, apply.
mnemonic: Knock, and the heart under the roof answers — オウ. 応援 is answering with noise; 反応 answering by reflex.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 假): person (亻) + 反 (phonetic カ) — a stand-in flipped into place: temporary, assumed.
mnemonic: Someone playing the part until the real one arrives — かり. 仮名: the 'borrowed names' that became hiragana.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 價): person (亻) + 賈 'merchant' — what the merchant says it's worth: price, value.
mnemonic: The stallholder squints at it and names a number — カ. 価格 is that number in print; 価値 what it's actually worth.

etymology: Compound: a mouth (口) with breath forced out crooked — the grunt of approval: permitted, possible.
mnemonic: The examiner's single grunt: passable — カ. 可能 opens doors; 不可 slams this same kanji shut.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 可 (phonetic カ) — originally the proper name of the Yellow River; then any great river.
mnemonic: The river so big it was just called The River — かわ. 銀河: the night sky's own 河.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — going past the mark: to pass, to exceed; going too far: an error.
mnemonic: You were supposed to stop back there — すぎる. 食べ過ぎ, 働き過ぎ: the kanji of one step too many; 過去 is everything already passed.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a blade (刀) parting the horn (角) from the ox (牛) — taking apart at the joints: to dissolve, to solve, to understand.
mnemonic: The butcher never forces: he finds where things already separate — とく, わかる. 解決 is doing that to a problem.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 夬 'burst open' (phonetic カイ) — the heart's dam breaking into relief: pleasant, brisk.
mnemonic: The blockage in the chest gives way: sudden clear water — こころよい. 快晴 is the sky's version of the feeling.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 各 (phonetic カク) — the squared frame each piece must fit: the standard; where you fit it: status.
mnemonic: The lattice every beam is measured against — カク. 合格: you fit the frame; 性格: the frame you were born with.

etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 隺 (phonetic カク) — solid as bedrock: certain, definite.
mnemonic: Tap it: stone all the way through — たしか. 確認 is tapping twice to be sure.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 客 (phonetic ガク) + head (頁) — the head's front: forehead; the plaque hung at that height: a framed sum, an amount.
mnemonic: The number on the plaque at eye level — ひたい for the brow, ガク for the bill. 金額: the forehead of an invoice.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 干 (phonetic カン) + blade (刂) — carving the printing blocks: to publish.
mnemonic: The knife cuts today's edition into the wood — カン. 朝刊: last night's carving on your doormat.

etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 貫 'strung through' (phonetic カン) — the heart threaded onto a routine like coins on a string: habit.
mnemonic: Do it enough times and the heart stops noticing the string — なれる. 習慣: coins of days, all strung.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the festival drum (壴) with a mouth (口) singing under it — music and voice together: joy.
mnemonic: Drumbeat plus a mouth that can't stay closed — よろこぶ. Good news comes with percussion.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic キ) + earth (土) — the tamped earth platform everything is raised on: base, foundation.
mnemonic: Before the walls: the packed square of ground — もと, キ. 基本 is that square, in study form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — coming in under another's roof: to draw near, drop in; to leave in their care: entrust.
mnemonic: Sidle up under the eaves out of the rain — よる. 駅に寄る: a small detour under a familiar roof; 寄付 leaves something behind.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the grown man (夫) sighting along his compass (見) — the tool that draws true circles: standard, regulation.
mnemonic: The master checks the arc by eye and it is law — キ. 規則: circles everyone must stay inside.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 支 'branch' (phonetic ギ) — the hand's many branches of ability: skill, technique.
mnemonic: One hand, a dozen learned branches — わざ. 技術 is the orchard fully grown.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 屰 'person upside down' (phonetic ギャク) — walking against the flow: reverse, contrary.
mnemonic: Everyone else is going the other way — and you're inverted too — ぎゃく. 逆に: the conversational U-turn.

etymology: Pictograph read as a person held steady from behind — made to last: enduring, a long time.
mnemonic: Propped so it stays put for years — ひさしい. 久しぶり: the kanji you say when the prop finally slips.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 求 'seek' (phonetic キュウ) + 攵 'acting hand' — the hand reaching in answer to the plea: to rescue.
mnemonic: Someone calls; a hand actually arrives — すくう. 救急車: the whole kanji with a siren on it.

etymology: Simplified from 舊 (an owl over a mortar, phonetic) — the former, the old: what the calendar already used up.
mnemonic: One thin stroke propping up an old sun — キュウ. 旧道, 旧姓: roads and names from before the renovation.

etymology: Phono-semantic: body settled (尸) + 古 'old' (phonetic キョ) — staying where one has long sat: to reside, to be present.
mnemonic: Sitting in the same spot until the spot is yours — いる. 居間: the room the family's 居る happens in.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 午 (phonetic キョ) — the word that grants: to permit, forgive.
mnemonic: One spoken yes and the gate unlocks — ゆるす. 免許: the yes laminated into a license.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 竟 'come to an end' (phonetic キョウ) — where the land ends: border, boundary.
mnemonic: The ground runs out of your name here — さかい. 環境: everything on both sides of your fence, technically.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 勻 'evenly distributed' (phonetic キン) — ground raked flat: level, equal.
mnemonic: Rake until no clump wins — キン. 平均: the number that flattens the whole class.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the sacred grove (林) around the altar (示) — ground no one may enter: forbidden.
mnemonic: Trees around the shrine: step back — キン. 禁止, 禁煙: the grove, now in sign form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 刑 (phonetic ケイ) + earth (土) — the clay form castings are pressed into: mould, model, type.
mnemonic: Press the clay, lift, repeat: identical every time — かた. 血液型, A型: humans sorted by mould.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 經): thread (糸) + 巠 'warp' — the long threads a weave runs on: to pass through (経る), the scripture lines (経), longitude.
mnemonic: The warp threads everything else crosses — ケイ. 経験 is what has passed along your threads; 経済 the nation's weave.

etymology: Compound: person (亻) + ox (牛) — a person's head of cattle, counted one by one: an item, a case, a matter.
mnemonic: Counting the herd item by item — ケン. 事件 is the case the police count; 3件のメール the cases in your inbox.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 檢): wood (木) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — the sealed wooden tallies checked one against another: to inspect, examine.
mnemonic: Open the wooden seals and compare — ケン. 検査 at the clinic, 検索 in the search bar: same double-check.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 險): mound (阝) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — slopes stacked steep: precipitous, perilous.
mnemonic: The hillside goes vertical where the path was promised — けわしい. 危険: the sign they bolt to it.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 咸 (phonetic ゲン) — the waterline dropping: to decrease, dwindle.
mnemonic: Yesterday's mark on the well wall is above today's — へる. 減る: the tide going out of anything.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 見 'see' (phonetic ゲン) — the polished stone's luster coming visible: to appear; what is visibly here: present, actual.
mnemonic: Polish until the gleam shows up in person — あらわれる. 現在, 現実: the here, the now, the actually-so.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 艮 'immovable' (phonetic ゲン) — the ridge you cannot pass: limit, restriction.
mnemonic: The hill that ends the argument — かぎる. 限界: where the path and your legs agree to stop.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 固 'solid' (phonetic コ) — one solid unit: an individual; the all-purpose counter 〜個.
mnemonic: One person, one solid piece, countable — コ. りんご3個: apples processed through this kanji.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 古 'old' (phonetic コ) + 攵 'act upon' — what old causes have knocked into being: reason, incident; the one now of the past: deceased.
mnemonic: Old causes still swinging their stick — ゆえ. 事故: when they hit the road; 故障: when they hit the machine.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 交 (phonetic コウ) + strength (力) — force that carries across: effect, efficacy.
mnemonic: Push here, and something over there actually moves — きく. 効果: the push, receipted.

etymology: Compound: strata piled under the cliff (厂) — thickness in layers; layered generosity: warm, kind.
mnemonic: Sediment stacked a canyon deep — あつい. 厚い本 for the shelf, 厚意 for the heart: both measured in layers.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 冓 'interlocked frame' (phonetic コウ) — timbers joined into a framework: structure; the stance one builds: posture.
mnemonic: Beams lattice into a standing frame — かまえる. 結構です: 'the structure is fine as is, thank you.'

etymology: Compound ideograph: the plow (耒) working the gridded well-field (井) — to till the land.
mnemonic: The plow drawing its lines across the grid — たがやす. 耕す: handwriting practice, but the page is a field.

etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 亢 (phonetic コウ) — the vessel crossing open water: to navigate, sail; extended to flight.
mnemonic: Prow up, horizon locked — コウ. 航空: the boat kanji that earned wings.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 冓 'framework' (phonetic コウ) — speech built beam on beam: a lecture, a course.
mnemonic: An argument with scaffolding — コウ. 講義: ninety minutes of word-carpentry.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 鑛): metal (金) + 広 (phonetic コウ) — metal still spread wide in the rock: ore.
mnemonic: The vein running broad through the mountain — コウ. 鉱山: where 金 is still homework.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the ox (牛) announced at the altar with the spoken word (口) — to declare formally: to tell, notify.
mnemonic: The announcement read out over the offering — つげる. 広告 declares to everyone; 報告 to your boss.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 昆 (phonetic コン) — many waters running together: to mix, blend, crowd.
mnemonic: Two rivers meet and forget which was which — まざる. 混雑: people doing it at rush hour.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 且 (phonetic サ) — probing with a wooden raft-pole: to examine, investigate.
mnemonic: Poke the pole in and see what comes up — サ. 調査: poking, but with clipboards.

etymology: Pictograph: a construction frame drawn with one beam repeated — once more: again, re-.
mnemonic: The same beam, installed twice — ふたたび. 再生, 再会: the replay button of kanji.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand pinning up a woman's hair — the coming-of-age coiffure of marriage: a wife.
mnemonic: The morning ritual of the pinned hair — つま. The kanji is a portrait of the wedding's day after.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 采 'hand over a tree, plucking' (phonetic サイ) — to gather, select, adopt.
mnemonic: Reach into the branches and choose — とる. 採用: the company picking you off the tree.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wall (阝) + 祭 (phonetic サイ) — where the wall meets the rite: the very edge, the juncture; a moment's juncture: occasion.
mnemonic: The line where two things touch — きわ. この際: 'at this juncture'; 国際: nations touching edges.
